author: Eclipciz
body:
• Your minecraft username. Darkshadow5678
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned. Hacking, anti knock back.
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server. Yes I admit I was hacking. That was 4 months ago, I have truly changed. I realized that hacking gets you nowhere, and now I really miss the server. I'm now good at pep and don't need hacks for any reason. It's not worth it. Thanks for reading my appeal I appreciate it.
